items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I think Sam kept Tommy because of his name. I think that's about the only reason. Because Tom had been over there before with Sam.

ctx.x: I wanted to ask you about Tommy Ladnier -- Sam apparently did not think very much of him as a trumpet player.
He didn't. I don't know why, but I think Sam kept Tommy because of his name. I think that's about the only reason. Because Tom had been over there before with Sam.
I know, he was with him, originally.
